verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK is documented as exposing the same tools, agent loop and context management that power Antigravity, programmable in Python with MCP, skills and attachments. A headless CLI mode supports scripting, CI integration and machine-readable output. However, there is no public REST/OpenAPI surface (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), and no evidence shows that UI-level features are reachable programmatically, such as Projects, Artifact review and comments, Scheduled Tasks, model selection, Remote Control and settings. Missing for 10: a documented public API or OpenAPI spec, explicit UI-to-API parity for Projects, Artifacts, scheduling and settings, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK or headless parity.
